title: Update on SMEs that have Benefited from Support and Stabilisation Package
what_it_is: Update on SMEs that have Benefited from Support and Stabilisation Package

sections.label: Enterprise loan support measures
sections.summary: As at 31 March, 662 enterprises took up loans with PFIs, and the Resilience Budget provides further working capital support, including the Temporary Bridging Loan and enhanced WCL.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As at 31 March, 662 enterprises have taken up loans with Participating Financial Institutions (PFIs).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Of these, 575 enterprises, or almost 90% are micro and small enterprises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As part of the $48 billion Resilience Budget announced by the Deputy Prime Minister, we will provide further support for enterprises to meet their working capital needs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Enterprises from all sectors are now eligible for the Temporary Bridging Loan or TBL where PFIs' lending rates are capped at 5% per annum.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: The maximum loan quantum supported under the TBL and the enhanced WCL has also been raised to $5 million and $1 million respectively.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Borrowers under the TBL and the enhanced WCL can also request to pay only interest on their loans for the first year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Approval will be subject to PFIs' assessment and the purpose is to help enterprises to reduce their monthly cash outflow.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: These include corporate income tax rebate and payment deferment; rental waiver for Government properties, which will benefit micro and small enterprises such as hawker stalls and HDB heartland shops, and the enhanced Jobs Support Scheme where the Government will pay part of the salaries for local employees to help enterprises with their cash flow and to save jobs.
